backstory.v: He calls a bold play and immediately asks for a second opinion. His HyperNorm playbook allows only forward progress or personal failure. He clutches the ball while translating a simple neighbourly request into a safely reversible instruction. A dissonant card proposing that asking for help could itself be leadership sits inside his helmet. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er übernimmt Verantwortung. Vorbehaltlich der Rückversicherung.

backstory.v: She provides protection with the patience of a locked filing cabinet. She guards the service corridor, judging visitors as protected or exposed. Her small shoulder pads have stopped more frightened apologies than opponents. She is starting to suspect that a barrier can also be a place to lean against. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Mauer steht. Anlehnen ist nach Feierabend gestattet.

backstory.v: He is certain the next pass will finally be addressed to him. He waits for permission to catch good news, which the building office invariably throws somewhere else. His empty gloves preserve the shape of a future promotion. A card about shared credit made him look at the neighbours instead of the ceiling. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er ist anspielbar. Die Verwaltung bestreitet den Zugang.

backstory.v: She carries the entire offence and would like that noted. She carries the building's errands under one arm and divides every task into hers or inexplicably also hers. The tucked football is much easier to protect than her afternoon. She has begun leaving small jobs for residents eager to be useful. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie trägt das Team. Eine Aufwandsentschädigung ist nicht vorgesehen.

backstory.v: He tackles uncertainty even when it is standing perfectly still. He supervises the stairwell and tackles every idea classified as uncontrolled movement. The oval pad is chiefly there to soften encounters he insists were unavoidable. A contradictory card has taught him to ask one question before blocking the answer. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Für den Zusammenstoß liegt eine Zuständigkeit vor.

backstory.v: He believes a specialist is someone allowed to be nervous in only one direction. He is the designated specialist whenever the building needs someone else to be nervous. The empty kicking boot promises precision without supplying a foot. He keeps a second chance for residents whose first attempt was watched too closely. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sein Spezialgebiet ist der nächste Versuch. Der vorige ist noch anhängig.
